online_confirmation.status: Not launched; this request authorizes finite target diagnostics.
online_confirmation.initialization: Identical verified boundary bundle, all optimizers/RNG/environments preserved, separate run identities, four ranks sequentially exclusive.
online_confirmation.comparison: Equal19200 natural games and common completed-round wall, final two5-round windows; require +0.5pp win or +2floor in both and no material win/common-time regression. Report all windows, exclusions, uncertainty and single-replica limitation.

candidate_interpretation.formula: Within room lambda=1. On room boundary, next scene g=(next act,next phase): lambda=.9+.07*abs(bias_g)/(abs(bias_g)+spread_g+.05). True terminal never bootstraps.
candidate_interpretation.calibration: For each calibration game/scene average frozen-old-V minus real whole-run MC; estimate mean and second moment across games. Shrink each scene with32 pseudo-games toward global per-game residual moments, then freeze before any temporary fitting. Spread includes outcome noise, not epistemic uncertainty.
candidate_interpretation.scope: Independent calibration games are excluded from optimizer training and validation. Actor original GAE.97, original rewards/search/state source and all optimizer settings stay fixed.
candidate_interpretation.comparison: Re-fit MC/constant.97/room.9 from identical source on the same480 training games; historical720-game fit numbers are not this experiment controls.
candidate_interpretation.repeat: Adaptive and MC both repeated exactly; no automatic post-result retuning or online adoption.
